site.name: Abhishek Soni
site.headline:
Imagination,
made visible.
site.intro: I work at the intersection of cinema, advertising and emerging technology. Turning an idea into a world you can see — and a story you can feel.
site.about: With a background in journalism and media, I bring a storyteller’s instinct to AI-powered production. My practice connects creative direction, generative imagery, filmmaking and digital content, from the first visual concept to the final frame.
site.contactText: For projects, collaborations, freelance work and professional opportunities.
site.description: AI advertising, films and visual experiences. Abhishek Soni brings cinema, generative AI and creative direction together.

projects.title: TISSOT
projects.subtitle: Time, refined
projects.description: An independent visual concept exploring the quiet precision of time. Sculpted light, tactile surfaces and a moment held still. Not commissioned by or affiliated with Tissot.

projects.title: PREET
projects.subtitle: Heritage in motion
projects.description: A fictional fashion concept where traditional textiles meet cinematic space. An exploration of movement, memory and the warmth of heritage.

projects.title: AFTERLIGHT
projects.subtitle: A trace of something
projects.description: A fictional fragrance concept. Amber, sand and the last light of the afternoon become a study in desire and restraint.
